title: Auto-Renew Charge Amount
content:
**Billing calculation note: the auto-renew charge on an SSL/TLS Certificates subscription**

An auto-renew charge renews the subscription from its subscription end date for the years of its latest term line, at most the longest subscription the product can be bought or renewed for, and its list amount is the tier's price for those years (the product's 1-year price, or its per-year price of a 2-year or 3-year subscription times the years) plus the product's price per added name per year times the extra names times the years; the auto-renew amount is that list amount rounded half up to the cent.

**The quantities and where they are read**

1. *Renewed years.* The latest term line is the subscription's latest renewal or auto-renew charge line by charge date or, where none has been billed, its purchase line. A renewal line later refunded still sets the term, being the term the customer last chose, and its refund has already brought the end date back. The years of that line, at most the product's longest subscription, are the renewed years.
2. *Certificate price component.* For one renewed year it is the product's 1-year price; for two or three renewed years it is the product's per-year price of a subscription of that length. That per-year price times the renewed years is the certificate price component.
3. *Extra-names component.* The product's price per added name per year times the extra names recorded on the subscription, times the renewed years.
4. *Assembly.* Every percentage reduction acts once on the price component it reduces, every multiplier of a name's yearly price acts on that yearly price, and the reduced amount, the sum of the price components, is rounded half up to the cent before any fixed fee is added or any fixed credit is subtracted; the result is then rounded half up to the cent.

The renewal runs from the subscription end date, never from the day the charge is taken: the new end date is that end date moved forward by the renewed years.

**Worked figure on hypothetical inputs (an invented price list, for illustration only)**

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| latest term line | a 2-year renewal line |
| per-year price of a 2-year subscription | 31.00 USD |
| price per added name per year | 9.00 USD |
| extra names recorded | 7 |

The certificate price component is 31.00 USD for each of 2 years, 62.00 USD. The extra-names component is 9.00 USD for each of 7 names for each of 2 years, 126.00 USD. Their sum, 188.00 USD, rounded half up to the cent, is an auto-renew amount of 188.00 USD, and the subscription end date moves two years later.

Had the latest term line been the subscription's 1-year purchase line, the renewed year would be one, the certificate price component the product's 1-year price, and the extra-names component the price per added name for one year.
